name: short-03-send-me-an-email
notes: BATCH-01 script #7. OBJECTION pillar. Hook: loss framing. Script-heavy structure.

scenes.text: "Send me an email" is a no wearing a suit.
scenes.vo: Send me an email is a no wearing a suit. Sometimes.

scenes.text: It means one of two things and you have to find out which.
scenes.vo: It means one of two completely different things, and you have to find out which.

scenes.caption: a polite no, or genuinely busy
scenes.vo: A polite no. Or genuinely busy.

scenes.label: SAY THIS
scenes.text: "Happy to. So I don't send you something useless — what would need to be in it for you to actually reply?"
scenes.vo: Happy to. So I don't send you something useless. What would need to be in it for you to actually reply?

scenes.text: A polite no can't answer that. They'll say "just send whatever."
scenes.vo: A polite no can't answer that. They'll say, just send whatever. That was your answer.

scenes.text: A busy person tells you exactly what to write.
scenes.vo: A genuinely busy person tells you exactly what to write. Now it's a warm email.
And never ask for their email. You already have it. Asking proves you didn't prepare.
